nodes.label: Cross-Artifact Consistency Analysis
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 在实现前以只读方式发现 spec、plan、tasks 与宪章之间的不一致、歧义和覆盖缺口。

nodes.label: Requirements Quality Checks
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 清单用于检验需求文本的完整性、清晰度、一致性与覆盖度，而不是验证实现行为。

nodes.label: Incremental Clarification Integration
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 每个已接受答案立即写回规格并重新验证，以减少上下文丢失和残留矛盾。

nodes.label: Constitution Consistency Propagation
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 宪章修订必须同步检查计划、规格、任务模板与运行指导，避免治理原则漂移。

nodes.label: Append-Only Convergence Phase
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 把规格与现有实现之间的剩余差距追加为可追溯任务，同时禁止重写既有任务或业务代码。

nodes.label: Test-First Task Execution
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 实现按阶段和依赖执行，测试任务先于对应实现，并在每个阶段设置验证检查点。

nodes.label: Research and Design Workflow
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 先通过研究消除技术未知项，再生成数据模型、契约与可运行的快速验证指南。

nodes.label: Feature Specification Generation
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 从自然语言需求生成面向用户价值、可测试且技术无关的规格，并用质量清单反复验证。

nodes.label: User-Story Task Generation
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 任务必须按用户故事和依赖排序，包含精确路径，并保持每个故事可独立实施与验证。

nodes.label: GitHub Issue Deduplication
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: 创建 Issue 前按 TNNN 任务编号遍历开放与关闭 Issue，防止重复创建并限制目标仓库。

nodes.label: Immutable Docs Baseline
nodes.rationale: 实现任务必须填写完整 docs 提交 SHA，并同时声明事实来源、范围、非目标、验收和验证计划。

nodes.label: Constitution and Docs Gate
nodes.rationale: 研究和设计前必须确认 Issue 固定 docs 提交、范围与验证明确，并且实现只面向 dev。

nodes.label: Independent Prioritized User Stories
nodes.rationale: 用户故事按价值优先级组织，每个故事必须可独立开发、测试、演示和交付。

nodes.label: Task Authorization Boundary
nodes.rationale: 任务文本本身不授权实现；必须由链接到固定 docs 提交的 Issue 明确授权在 dev 开始。

nodes.label: Specification and Plan Review Gates
nodes.rationale: 完整 SDD 流程在 specification 与 plan 之后分别设置人工批准或拒绝门禁。

nodes.label: Kindergarten Isolation Boundary
nodes.rationale: Retaining kindergarten_id from the first release avoids a future rewrite of core tables, unique constraints, repositories, and audit relationships while not prematurely building a multi-kindergarten SaaS.

nodes.label: Separate Web API Worker Modular Monolith
nodes.norm_label: separate web api worker modular monolith

nodes.label: Web API Worker Service Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Independent runtime units keep UI, authorization, data access, and long-running work separated without incurring the operational cost of full microservices.

nodes.label: Recoverable Idempotent Async Execution
nodes.rationale: Redis delivery is not atomic with database commit, so persistent pending state, recovery scans, leases, and business idempotency are required to converge safely.

nodes.label: API Authoritative Authorization
nodes.rationale: Authorization remains in the API so Web presentation choices cannot become the effective security boundary.

nodes.label: Immutable Traceable Export Copies
nodes.rationale: Generating from a read-only template copy and retaining a distinct export record prevents template damage, output overwrite, and loss of template provenance.

nodes.label: External Service Soft Degradation
nodes.rationale: Calendar and AI dependencies must not block manual lesson-plan work, and an unknown workday result must remain explicitly unknown rather than being fabricated as a workday.

nodes.label: Security Results Survive Deployment Deferral
nodes.rationale: Deferring production products and topology does not defer service boundaries, server-side authorization, data isolation, same-origin cookie safety, or secret-exclusion requirements.

nodes.label: Authentication Assurance Separation
nodes.rationale: A backup session may use ordinary business features, but phishing-susceptible factors must not silently acquire WebAuthn assurance for high-risk identity operations.

nodes.label: Trust Starts at the API
nodes.rationale: Browser and Web/BFF inputs are untrusted; only the API can construct identity context from server-side session state and enforce role, kindergarten, and class authorization.

nodes.label: Deep Module Interfaces
nodes.rationale: A small use-case interface should hide authorization, transaction, persistence, retry, and external integration complexity instead of exposing repositories or generic provider calls.

nodes.rationale: 十六项规格质量检查均通过，产品歧义、权限边界、任务幂等与身份恢复约束已经历多轮复核。

nodes.label: Trusted NiceGUI BFF Boundary
nodes.rationale: 浏览器只访问 NiceGUI Web；BFF 剥离伪造代理头并转发 Cookie、来源、CSRF 和多个 Set-Cookie，API 只信任显式回环 BFF 重建的来源。

nodes.label: Optimistic Lock and Idempotency Contract
nodes.rationale: 教案写入使用 expected_version；AI、提示词测试、显式重试和导出以园所、操作者、方法、路由模板和请求摘要定义幂等作用域。

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Job Authority
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL background_jobs 是唯一任务事实来源；Redis 和 Dramatiq 只传递最小 job_id，pending_dispatch 扫描与租约恢复收敛故障窗口。

nodes.label: Retry and Idempotency Semantics
nodes.rationale: 模型调用最多三次；显式重试创建关联的新任务并复制冻结输入，基础设施重投不增加业务 attempt_count。

nodes.label: AI Preview Adoption Transaction
nodes.rationale: 采用事务重新鉴权并校验版本、栏目基线与输入哈希，只有有效预览才合并正文、创建快照并写审计。

nodes.label: Kindergarten-Scoped Entities
nodes.rationale: 业务表、复合外键、Repository 与唯一约束共同携带 kindergarten_id，避免跨园读取和写入。

nodes.label: Plan, Job, and AI Result Invariants
nodes.rationale: 教案版本、不可变快照、后台任务、AI 结果占位与导出记录以组合外键和单事务维护一致性。
nodes.norm_label: plan, job, and ai result invariants

nodes.label: Provider-Neutral AI and Prompt Contracts
nodes.rationale: 七个稳定提示词使用白名单变量和固定结构化结果，业务通过 OpenAI 兼容边界而不绑定供应商。

nodes.label: Reliable Jobs, Key Envelope, and SSRF Security
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL 权威任务与租约恢复保证异步可靠性；AI Key 使用 AEAD 信封，模型地址在受理和外呼前执行 SSRF 安全复核。
nodes.norm_label: reliable jobs, key envelope, and ssrf security

nodes.label: Backup Login Specification Quality Checklist
nodes.rationale: 密码与 TOTP 备用登录规格的十六项内容、完整性与可验收性检查全部通过。

nodes.label: Password and TOTP Backup Login API Fragment
nodes.norm_label: password and totp backup login api fragment

nodes.label: Encrypted Credentials and Enrollments
nodes.rationale: 密码摘要与 TOTP 信封位于独立园所范围表；短时 enrollment 与已启用凭据分离，种子只展示一次并以 AES-256-GCM 保存。

nodes.label: Session Assurance and TOTP Replay Protection
nodes.rationale: 会话记录 authentication_method 与短时再验证，last_accepted_counter 以原子条件更新阻止 TOTP 重放，backup_auth_version 撤销旧备用会话。
nodes.norm_label: session assurance and totp replay protection

nodes.label: Identity Deep Module Reuse
nodes.rationale: 备用登录复用既有身份、会话、限流、审计与 WebAuthn 边界，不创建第二套认证服务，也不把秘密字段放回 users。

nodes.label: Recovery Is Not Downgraded
nodes.rationale: 失去全部通行密钥时仍要求离线恢复码与人工核验；恢复后旧密码、TOTP、通行密钥、会话、邀请和恢复码全部失效。

nodes.label: Argon2id and RFC 6238 TOTP
nodes.rationale: 密码采用 Argon2id 和渐进重摘要；TOTP 使用 RFC 6238 固定参数、有限时间窗与持久 counter 重放保护。

nodes.label: AES-GCM Secret Envelope and Layered Throttling
nodes.rationale: TOTP 种子使用数据库外主密钥与 AAD 绑定的 AES-GCM 信封；公开备用登录按来源、账号摘要和全局三层独立限流。
nodes.norm_label: aes-gcm secret envelope and layered throttling

nodes.label: Password and TOTP Backup Login Feature
nodes.norm_label: password and totp backup login feature

nodes.label: Phishing-Resistant Primary Path
nodes.rationale: WebAuthn 保持首选登录和高风险因素管理手段，密码与 TOTP 必须同时成立且其再验证只允许新增通行密钥。

nodes.label: Backup Login RED to GREEN Gate
nodes.rationale: T003-T009 先冻结可收集的安全 RED，再按基础 GREEN、三个用户故事和完整复核顺序实施。
nodes.norm_label: backup login red to green gate
